notes:
• Import and Export are back — export any chapter as PDF or CBZ.
• Faster, smarter search.
• Manga with a new chapter come back to the front of Continue Reading.
• More reliable notifications (Settings → Notifications).
• Choose how pages turn in the reader.

changes: Import is back: add a manga from a ZIP, CBZ or PDF on your phone, or add chapter files to one you already have — a ZIP full of PDFs works too. Hidden and broken files inside a ZIP are skipped. See and delete your imported chapters on the Import page. Imports stay on your phone.

Export is back: save any chapter as PDF or CBZ in Downloads/Mangaku, each manga in its own folder — chapters you haven't downloaded are fetched first. PDFs are much smaller now, and long chapters no longer fail.
Search is faster and smarter: results show in under a second, and the series you're looking for comes first instead of side stories and fan works.
Continue Reading: when a manga you've caught up on gets a new chapter, it comes back by itself — at the front, with a "New chapter" label. Pull down on Home to check right away.

More reliable notifications: Mangaku checks for new chapters and updates every 2 hours. The new Settings → Notifications page shows what's blocking them (with one-tap fixes on Xiaomi phones), sends a test notification, or checks right now.
Xiaomi Super Island now looks like Mangaku's own island: the cover with your reading progress, and Continue / Next chapter buttons when you open it. New chapters get a Read button.
Reader: choose how pages turn — Page flip, Slide, Fade, Zoom, Depth, Cube or Stack (Settings → Reading).
A manga you add now starts without a source, so you pick the one you like. MangaDex shows up in the list when it has the title.
Marking a manga Completed fills in its last chapter for you — when you add it, and on its page.
Home: the first letter under covers in Keep going, Trending and Recommended is no longer cut off.
Removing a manga you imported from files also frees the space its pages used.
A big animation update: pages slide and fade in, cards squish a little when you tap them, lists cascade in, and loading shows shimmering placeholders.
Open a manga from your Library and its cover flies into the manga page.
Home: Continue Reading is now a stack of cards that glides on by itself and follows your swipes. Pull down to refresh. Scroll down and the bottom bar slides away; scroll up and it's back.
Manga page: see which people you follow have the manga, whether it's ongoing, finished or cancelled, a heart animation for favorites, and a smoother Read more.
Fixed: your library now saves to your account properly. Before, it could fail to upload, so other devices and your followers didn't see it.
Fixed: changing a manga's source now really loads the new source's chapters.
Share cards for a manga and for your stats, with a link and a QR code that open Mangaku on that manga or your profile.
Send feedback, questions or ideas from Settings.
A short tour on every screen the first time you open it. Replay it any time from Settings → About.
Reading island (Settings → Reading): a new look, alerts for new chapters, download progress, and an optional reading reminder at the time you usually read.
Xiaomi phones: Mangaku can use Xiaomi's Super Island (Settings → Reading).
Notifications show the manga's cover, and you can swipe them away in the list.
Reader: next-chapter buttons, a page flip in paged mode, and it remembers exactly where you stopped.
Choose an app icon and theme in Appearance; frosted-glass buttons follow your theme's colors.
Hold a manga in your Library to select several. Your profile stats count up, and you can edit your profile on a new card.
Import and Export are being rebuilt and will come back in a later update.

Updates now download inside the app, so they no longer get stuck on some phones. After you allow installing apps, the update continues by itself, and if a download fails you can download it in the browser.
Better zoom while reading: pinch to zoom, double-tap a spot to zoom in on it, and drag to move around — in every reading mode, including webtoon.
Home: every manga you are reading now sits in one swipeable Continue Reading row of wide cards with banner art.
Recommended for you no longer shows manga that are already in your library.
Settings is back in the bottom bar, and the Home search button was removed.
Updates now come from a new home: Kamal142-D/mangaku-releases.
The Library category bar is now centered.
New liquid-glass selection in the bottom bar: tap a tab and the glass glides over, or hold and drag across the tabs.
The Library categories (All, Reading, Plan to read, Completed) use the same gliding glass pill.
On Android 13 and newer, the glass bends what is under its edge while you drag.
Notifications when a manga you're reading gets a new chapter.
Notifications when someone starts following you.
Notifications when a new version of Mangaku is available.
This window now shows what's new in every version since yours.
Home: frosted top bar.
Continue Reading shows manga you're reading and haven't finished.
Keep going shows Plan to read and barely-started manga.
User search and user profiles redesigned with frosted-glass buttons.
Restore from Google Drive recovers your last real backup if the latest one was empty.
Backups never upload an empty library over an existing backup.
Fixed a crash when opening Backup & restore.
Opening the Google Drive page no longer starts a backup by itself.
Opening Reading settings no longer changes the reader mode by itself.
The update window appears every time you open the app while a newer version exists.
Google Drive backup works in the release build.
